flows:
Navigate to https://radar.weather.gov/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Press Tab twice before making any accessibility assertion.
Continue using Tab or Shift+Tab through the controls to reach Play in the radar animation timeline.
Press Enter and verify the animation begins and the control changes to Pause.

summary:
The Play control was built as a non-focusable element instead of a keyboard-focusable control.
Change Play to a native button, or give it proper keyboard focus and Enter/Space support. Retest by tabbing from the page start until Play receives focus, then press Enter and confirm that its label changes to Pause.
evidence: objective_contradiction: After two Tabs, focus cycles only between header links; Play is a non-focusable div with tabIndex -1.
one_liner: The visible Play control cannot be reached with Tab, so keyboard-only users cannot start the radar animation.
